capabilities: Sync the whole vault to a GitHub remote with one click
Resolve merge conflicts per file in a dialog
Preview changes and selectively stage files before a commit
Auto-sync on startup or on a timer
Exclude paths by glob pattern and .gitignore
extras: Warning: the Personal Access Token is stored in plaintext in the plugin's data.json and should be gitignored. Commit preview/selective sync works only on the desktop git engine, not the mobile GitHub API engine.
intentEvidence: Pure JavaScript, no system Git required.
problem: Obsidian's built-in Sync is paid and proprietary, and Git-based sync on mobile is hard because system Git is unavailable and large packfiles exhaust memory.

relations.evidence: All Git operations go through isomorphic-git over Obsidian's own filesystem and HTTP
BRAT installs plugins straight from a GitHub repo and keeps them updated.

requires.name: Git repository on GitHub (or any HTTPS Git host)

summary: Git sync plugin that pushes and pulls the whole vault to a GitHub remote with one click, including interactive conflict resolution and commit preview.
